content.comment_body: Hello, I found an old [product_name] and I'm looking for the latest version of [product_name] software that supports this legacy hardware. Any assistance would be appreciated. Thanks.

You need a [product_name] software version that matches or is newer than your [product_name] hardware version. From your description, it looks like you have the [article_no]. You can use [product_name] software versions from [version_no] up to [version_no]. In the software, make sure to select the correct hardware version—this can be done with CTRL + H or by clicking the icon in the lower right corner.
Yes, it's [article_no]. Does [product_name] software [version_no] support older [product_name] controllers?
I just installed [product_name] software [version_no], and it appears my legacy [product_name] isn't supported. Which is the newest version that still supports this hardware?

You should select your hardware in the diagram mode, since your [article_no] isn't network-compatible. Create a new diagram and then go to File Properties > Hardware to pick the correct device. Check the attached video for reference.

Apologies for not mentioning earlier: a) Use CTRL + H and pick the right hardware version; b) Click on the icon at the lower right of the screen to select the version; or c) Go to TOOLS at the top tab, then Select Hardware, and pick the correct device. You'll only be able to do this either when starting with a blank program, or if your program fits the hardware you want to use.

Thank you for the support! [snip] -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- A new question was posted in a separate thread about how to check when the connection to the hardware is established. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users working with legacy [product_name] hardware (such as [article_no] model) needed clarification on which [product_name] software versions could still configure these older devices. There was initial uncertainty about compatibility with newer releases of the software, as recent versions seemed to not recognize older controllers without manual selection. Community advice explained that it's necessary to manually choose the older hardware model in the software settings and that some features, like network mode, are unavailable for these versions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users hope that the latest release of [product_name] software will offer easy programming and configuration for older hardware, with clear options for identifying and selecting legacy models.
